tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List all graphic design services offered by Balaji Graphics, with a short description for each.

tools.name: get_service
tools.title: Get service details
tools.description: Get the full description and all pricing packages for one Balaji Graphics service, by its id (use list_services to find ids).

id.description: Service id, e.g. logo-design or wedding-card-design.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.title: Get pricing
tools.description: Get pricing packages for Balaji Graphics. Returns every service when no id is given, or one service's packages when an id is provided.

id.description: Optional service id to filter by.

tools.name: list_portfolio
tools.title: List portfolio and reviews
tools.description: List Balaji Graphics portfolio work samples and customer testimonials shown on the website.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.title: Get contact info
tools.description: Get Balaji Graphics contact details and a ready-to-use WhatsApp ordering link, optionally prefilled with a message about a service.

serviceId.description: Optional service id to prefill the WhatsApp enquiry message.
